name: heat_limit
quote: In particular, the display gets hot in ambient temperatures above 55 °C (131 °F), during extended sta- tionary periods, for example, at a traffic light, or in direct sunlight.

name: salt_wash
quote: After EVERY trip on salted roads, thoroughly clean the motorcycle and, in particular, the brake calipers and brake linings, after they have cooled down and without removing them, with cold water and dry carefully.
